none: PAS CAM-41F427: Roman copper alloy nummus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy nummus coin of the House of Valentinian, AD364-78, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Reverse shows Emperor dragging captive right. Measuring 16.94mm in diameter and weighing 1.99g. Obverse legend reads [ ]. Obverse shows Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed Bust right
